dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Smoothly concave trailing edge fitting a continuous spline from the apex to the posterior ridge insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological peak with a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Incline of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is approximately 1.5 times the maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Uniform convex curvature along the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and robust rostrum extending from the melon inflection point with a relatively thick pixel width.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse angle at the junction where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent pale, oval-shaped lesion on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the dorsal fin; small pale marking on the dorsal ridge anterior to the fin insertion.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible eye positioned posterior to the rostrum base; single pectoral fin extending ventrally from the thoracic region.
